verdict.rationale: The Reach page documents offices/qualified practices across multiple jurisdictions (Casablanca, Sydney, Beijing, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Singapore, plus European offices implied elsewhere), and practice pages emphasize 'international' and 'cross-border' expertise (e.g. VC practice noted as leader in UK/Europe with presence known in Asia/US, IP team handling matters across regions). This directly supports the founder story that expansion across borders can be served by one firm rather than needing a second. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of full multi-jurisdictional bar admissions/qualified practice per office, or independent verification (e.g. directory listing) beyond the firm's own site.
